title: Heavenly Secrets Display Their Might
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji's battle made him famous, but the price had quietly descended—the backlash from the Tianji Record surged like a tide, his head pierced by ten thousand needles.

text.content: The prophecy Ling Yuan left behind hung over his head like a sword. Before Chen Ji could even catch his breath, hidden undercurrents were already stirring within the sect. Before the morning bell rang, disciples had already gathered at the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, their whispers buzzing like a swarm of bees. The demonic path's challenge in three days—this news spread like wildfire through the entire sect, and standing at the center of the crowd, challenging the younger generation by name, was the former sect master who once dominated everything.

Chen Ji stood behind the crowd, his expression as dull as usual, only the fingers inside his sleeve tightening slightly. Ling Yuan's provocation was too deliberate, too ostentatious—this was not a simple challenge, but a carefully designed Yangming scheme. Whether he accepted or not, Ling Yuan could use this opportunity to nail him to the pillar of shame. The four words 'waste disciple' would forever become a stumbling block on his path forward.

dialogue.content: The crowd automatically parted, and Su Qingyao, wearing the robe of an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, walked up to Chen Ji with a cold expression. She lowered her voice, a rare anxiety flickering between her brows: 'Ling Yuan has personally entered the arena—this matter is by no means as simple as it appears. In these three days, do not act rashly.'

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze toward Su Qingyao calm as still water, yet the corner of his lips curved into a faint arc: 'Thank you, Senior Sister Su, for your concern.' His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached the other's ears. 'However, some things cannot be avoided by hiding.' With that, he had already turned toward the direction of the Scripture Library, his silhouette stretching into a thin shadow in the morning light.

Deep within the Scripture Library, Chen Ji sat cross-legged, slowly unfurling the damaged Tianji Record. On the yellowed pages, ink-like symbols moved like living creatures, emanating a faint blue glow. He took a deep breath, and according to the cultivation method Mo Xiansheng had described, slowly injected his divine sense into the third layer of the formation. A tearing, intense pain exploded from his brow center—the third layer of the Tianji Record was far more dangerous than the first two.

Yet after the agony passed, an unprecedented clarity flooded his mind. Three blurry images appeared in Chen Ji's pupils—first, Ling Yuan's right shoulder slightly sunken, a momentary stagnation in his true qi flow; second, a very faint scar on his left ribs, a trace of old injury not yet healed; third, within three feet of his body, there was a fatal blind spot in true elemental circulation. Three vulnerabilities, all exposed!

The price of the Tianji Record was clearly evident at this moment—Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining like a broken dam, each breath bringing stabbing headaches. But the corner of his lips slowly lifted, his eyes glittering with a dangerous light. Ling Yuan, you think you've set a deadly trap, but you don't know this deadly ground was set up for me.

Three days passed in an instant. At the Martial Arena, Ling Yuan, wearing a black Daoist robe, sat upright on the high platform, looking down at the sea of disciples below. Wherever his gaze swept, disciples lowered their heads, none daring to meet his eyes. That overwhelming momentum pressed down like a physical force, making the air thick. 'What, is there truly no one from Tianqing Sect's younger generation who dares to accept the challenge?'

Before his laughter faded, a flat voice came from behind the crowd: 'The junior Chen Ji is willing to try.' Everyone turned back to see that unremarkable servant disciple, walking step by step toward the center of the arena. His pace was not fast, yet steady as a rock, each step striking Ling Yuan's nerves. The crowd erupted in uproar—the waste dares challenge the former sect master?

dialogue.content: A flash of surprise crossed Ling Yuan's eyes, then turned to disdain: 'Oh? It's you?' He slowly rose, his momentum pressing down like mountain and mountain, 'I thought Tianqing Sect had no one left. I didn't expect them to send a servant to die. Very well, let me show you what true cultivation truly means—'

text.content: 'Wait.' Chen Ji suddenly interrupted, his voice not loud yet clearly spreading across the entire arena. His calm gaze fell on Ling Yuan without a trace of fear, 'Since Elder Ling wishes to battle, the junior presumes to ask a few questions before the fight begins.' Before the words even finished, the entire arena had fallen silent. This waste dares to stop the former sect master before everyone's eyes?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped forward and announced loudly: 'The junior has heard that thirty years ago, Elder Ling once engaged in fierce battle with a demonic path expert, returning wounded. May I ask, Elder, has the old injury to your right shoulder fully healed?' Ling Yuan's expression slightly changed, yet he coldly laughed: 'Boy, you're speaking nonsense—' But Chen Ji continued: 'The sword wound on your left ribs aches faintly whenever it rains. Am I correct in what I say?'

text.content: Ling Yuan's smile froze on his face. Whispered discussions began rising in the crowd, some showing shocked expressions, others full of suspicion. Yet Chen Ji acted as if unaware, continuing: 'What intrigues me even more is that Elder Ling's method of true elemental circulation seems to have a fatal blind spot—within three feet of his body. If an opponent's movement technique is fast enough, they could precisely seize that momentary gap...' As he spoke the final words, his gaze was like a blade, stabbing directly into Ling Yuan's eyes.

Ling Yuan's expression had transformed from initial disdain to disbelief and shock, finally settling on a near-distorted fury. The momentum around him suddenly surged, his black Daoist robe rippling without wind, a suffocating pressure crushing toward Chen Ji. Yet Chen Ji stood motionless, only slightly tilting his head, revealing a meaningful smile. 'Why must Elder Ling be so agitated? The junior is merely speaking the truth.'

The entire arena erupted in uproar. Ling Yuan's hidden old injuries, exposed before everyone by a waste disciple? What did this mean? The crowd's gazes shifted repeatedly between Chen Ji and Ling Yuan, the originally one-sided situation completely reversed at this moment. Ling Yuan's chest heaved剧烈起伏, a killing intent flickering in those clouded old eyes, yet he forcibly suppressed it.

dialogue.content: 'Good... good eloquent servant!' Ling Yuan's voice squeezed through his teeth, every word carrying bone-deep coldness, 'I underestimated you. But do you think a few words can make this Elder retreat?' He stepped forward, about to explode—

text.content: 'Enough.' A cold voice suddenly rang out, Su Qingyao had somehow appeared at Chen Ji's side, her gaze like a sword, directly facing Ling Yuan, 'Elder Ling, you, as an elder, repeatedly make things difficult for a servant disciple over and over. That might not sound very good if it got out, right? Today's matter ends here.' Her words were neither servile nor overbearing, yet carried an implicit warning.

Ling Yuan's expression was terrifyingly gloomy. He stared fixedly at Chen Ji, as if wanting to carve this waste disciple's appearance into his bones. After a long while, he suddenly threw his head back and laughed wildly, the laughter echoing through the Martial Arena: 'Good! Good! Good! Chen Ji, was it? This Elder remembers you!' With that, he swept his sleeve and left, his figure disappearing toward the sect gate.

Yet in the instant Ling Yuan turned, Chen Ji's body suddenly wavered. A tearing, intense pain spread from his brow center throughout his entire body—the Tianji Record's backlash had arrived as promised. His vision began to blur, a buzzing filled his ears, his Heavenly Fate Value draining at a terrifying speed. Headache to the point of bursting—this was the price for forcibly opening the third layer.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan had retreated, but Chen Ji had reached his limit. Now with everyone's eyes upon him, what choice should he make?

choices.description: While Ling Yuan's morale was at its lowest, strike again publicly, crushing his dignity completely beneath your feet, making him unable to rise forever.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation soars greatly, Ling Yuan humiliated
choices.risk_hint: The price is extremely high, possible fainting on the spot

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing his swaying body to stand. He called out loudly toward Ling Yuan's departing back: 'Elder Ling, your old injuries are severe, yet not beyond cure. Regrettable, someone with a mind as narrow as yours will probably never understand the profound principle within.' When his voice fell, the entire arena erupted in uproar again.

text.content: Ling Yuan's footsteps suddenly paused, his shoulders trembling violently, clearly enraged to the extreme. Yet he did not look back, only quickening his pace of departure. This scene in everyone's eyes was no different from confirming that Chen Ji's words were indeed true. For a time, those gazes that originally looked down on Chen Ji now carried traces of fear.

choices.description: Retreat at the peak of victory, stop pressing the advantage, to avoid excessive drain. Use today's matter as a bargaining chip for future negotiations, keeping a hidden trump card.

He lightly nodded toward Su Qingyao, his voice flat as if merely commenting on the weather: 'Thank you, Senior Sister Su, for your intervention. The junior feels somewhat unwell and will take his leave first.' With that, he turned and walked toward the back of the crowd, his pace still neither fast nor slow.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao gazed at Chen Ji's departing silhouette, a complex light flickering in her eyes. This servant disciple was far more unfathomable than she had imagined. She suddenly spoke: 'Brother Chen, your body... is it truly alright?' Chen Ji's footsteps paused, yet he did not look back, only saying lightly: 'Some things, Senior Sister will eventually know.'

choices.memory_label: 陈机深藏不露，令苏青瑶更加在意

text.content: The crowd gradually dispersed, yet the discussions did not cease for a long time. The name of 'waste' Chen Ji was, for the first time, seriously mentioned by so many people. And that former servant disciple, at this moment walking alone in the depths of the corridor, had blood seeping from his nostrils, sliding down the corner of his lips. Headache like splitting, the draining sensation of Heavenly Fate Value like ten thousand ants gnawing at his heart—the Tianji Record's backlash never changes because of victory or defeat.

Chen Ji leaned against a corridor pillar, looking up at the sky. Ling Yuan's retreat was only temporary; that old fox would never let this go. Today's victory was merely tearing open a corner of his hypocritical mask. And the true storm was only beginning to brew. He raised his hand to wipe away the blood at the corner of his lips, yet his eyes held not a trace of regret. Worth it. He silently recited in his heart. For that bigger chess game, it was all worth it.

Chen Ji's battle made him famous, but the price had quietly descended. The backlash from the Tianji Record surged like a tide, his consciousness gradually blurring, as if his entire being was being dragged into an endless abyss. His head felt pierced by ten thousand needles, every nerve screaming. In his last remnant of consciousness, he saw a blurry figure rushing toward him—it was Su Qingyao.
